prompt: Create FOUR chronological full-body RIGHT-facing knockdown animation frames of EXACT Takeda Shingen from references. Reference1 fixes face, stocky powerful build, gold horn helmet, white lion mane, red-gold armor, tiger surcoat, black gold four-diamond 風林火山 back banner, red-black oval gunbai war fan and sheathed sword. Reference2 fixes anatomy size. Preserve every item in EVERY frame, fan in right hand, banner attached naturally and tilting with torso. 1 standing heavy recoil from chest hit, knees soft, head back slightly. 2 buckling deeply onto one knee, torso still near upright, left hand reaching down, fan held close chest. 3 hips descend onto heels, torso twists and falls to right, supporting left palm on ground, knees folded tightly. 4 fully collapsed on right side, head and chest low, knees tightly drawn up curled body, fan close to chest, attached banner inclines diagonally up-left with full pole visible. Clear impact->knee collapse->fall->settled down, not four standing poses. Same bone lengths/head size/armor dimensions EVERY frame; do not shrink final figure. Compact curled fall silhouette width less than standing height, keep horns/mane/flag/fan/boots fully within cell. No long outstretched legs or weapons. Flat pure #FF00FF background no shadows/effects/blood/light/text/UI/labels except existing banner inscription. FOUR separate equal square cells in a 2x2 intermediate atlas row-major, generous gutters, NO grid. Consistent anatomy scale, first standing figure 80 percent cell height, ground90 percent, all figure parts retained. Final game strip will be1024x256,256x256 per frame.
